_note: 英語島文法分區 sidecar：一檔一單元一 KP。unit_id＝KP id＝eng.t_adv.verb.tense-consistency（時態一致，tier t_adv／學測級）。原則：同一段敘述、同一時間軸內，動詞時態要一致，不可無故跳時態（She opened the door and walked in，兩動詞皆過去）。過去敘事保持過去、現在習慣/事實保持現在；只有在『時間真的改變』時才換時態（I lost my keys yesterday, so now I am looking for them——過去→現在，由 yesterday vs now 正當化）。MCQ 每題唯一可辯護正解＋distractor_rationales＋answer_evidence。R14：teach body 全英文、中文放 zh_hint。以 Swan/Cambridge/Oxford 查證、status provisional、待英語母語 reviewer 複核。含純文字 shadowing（無音檔）。

units.title_zh: 時態一致（同一時間軸不無故跳時態）
units.can_do: 我能在同一段敘述裡保持動詞時態一致——過去敘事維持過去、現在習慣維持現在，只有在時間真的改變時才正當地換時態。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: Within one piece of writing about a single time frame, keep the verb tenses consistent; do not switch tense without a real change in time: 'She opened the door and walked in.' (both past) — not 'She opened the door and walks in.'
claims.verification_ref: 同一時間軸的敘述時態要一致、不可無故跳時態（She opened the door and walked in，非 …and walks in）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When telling a story set in the past, keep the related verbs in the past: 'He woke up, got dressed, and ate breakfast.' (all past)
claims.verification_ref: 講過去的故事時，相關動詞保持過去式（He woke up, got dressed, and ate breakfast，皆過去）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When describing present facts or habits, keep the verbs in the present: 'Every morning she wakes up early and goes for a run.' (all present)
claims.verification_ref: 描述現在事實/習慣時，動詞保持現在式（Every morning she wakes up early and goes for a run，皆現在）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Change tense only when the time really changes — for example, moving from a past event to its present result: 'I lost my keys yesterday, so now I am looking for them.' (past -> present, justified by 'yesterday' vs 'now')
claims.verification_ref: 只有時間真的改變時才換時態（I lost my keys yesterday, so now I am looking for them；過去→現在，由 yesterday 與 now 正當化）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Within one piece of writing about the same time frame, keep the verb tenses consistent. Do not jump from one tense to another unless the time really changes. A sudden, unneeded tense shift confuses the reader.
teach.zh_hint: 在同一段、同一時間軸的敘述裡，動詞時態要保持一致。除非時間真的改變，否則不要從一個時態突然跳到另一個。無故跳時態會讓讀者困惑。

teach.body: Consistent (past): She opened the door and walked in. / Inconsistent (wrong): She opened the door and walks in.
teach.zh_hint: 一致（過去）：She opened the door and walked in.（開門、走進去皆過去）不一致（錯）：She opened the door and walks in.（opened 過去卻跳到 walks 現在）

teach.body: When you tell a story set in the past, keep the related verbs in the past. When you describe present facts or habits, keep the verbs in the present.
teach.zh_hint: 講過去的故事時，相關動詞都保持過去式；描述現在的事實或習慣時，動詞都保持現在式。

teach.body: Past story: He woke up, got dressed, and ate breakfast. / Present habit: Every morning she wakes up early and goes for a run.
teach.zh_hint: 過去故事：He woke up, got dressed, and ate breakfast.（皆過去）現在習慣：Every morning she wakes up early and goes for a run.（皆現在）

teach.body: Of course, you may change tense when the time really changes — for example, when you move from a past event to a present result. Time words like 'yesterday' and 'now' can signal and justify the shift.
teach.zh_hint: 當然，時間真的改變時可以換時態——例如從過去的事件轉到現在的結果。像 yesterday、now 這類時間詞會提示並正當化這個轉換。

teach.body: Justified shift: I lost my keys yesterday, so now I am looking for them. (past -> present)
teach.zh_hint: 正當的轉換：I lost my keys yesterday, so now I am looking for them.（昨天弄丟鑰匙→現在正在找；過去→現在，由 yesterday 與 now 正當化）

practice.stem: 填入正確（與前面時態一致）：Last night, she finished her homework and ____ to bed early.（昨晚她寫完功課就早早上床了）
options: went
goes
will go
is going

distractor_rationales.goes: 前面 Last night、finished 都是過去；同一時間軸要一致，用過去式 went，不可跳成現在式 goes。
distractor_rationales.will go: will go 是未來；敘述的是昨晚發生的事，要用過去式。
distractor_rationales.is going: is going 是現在進行式；與過去的時間軸不一致。

practice.feedback: Last night ＋ finished（過去）→ 保持過去式 went。

practice.stem: 填入正確（與前面時態一致）：Every day he gets up at six and ____ for a walk.（他每天六點起床然後去散步）
options: goes
went
will go
going

distractor_rationales.went: 前面 Every day、gets up 是現在式，描述習慣；同一句要一致用 goes，不可跳成過去 went。
distractor_rationales.will go: 描述每天的習慣用現在簡單式，不用未來 will go。
distractor_rationales.going: 單獨 going 不能當主要動詞，需要助動詞。

practice.feedback: Every day ＋ gets up（現在習慣）→ 保持現在式 goes。

practice.stem: 下列哪一句時態不一致（同一時間軸卻無故換時態）？
practice.answer: She sat down, opened her book, and starts to read.
options: She sat down, opened her book, and starts to read.
She sat down, opened her book, and started to read.
She sits down, opens her book, and starts to read.
She will sit down, open her book, and start to read.

distractor_rationales.She sat down, opened her book, and start: 三個動詞都是過去式，時態一致，正確。
distractor_rationales.She sits down, opens her book, and start: 三個都是現在式，一致，正確。
distractor_rationales.She will sit down, open her book, and st: 都在未來時間軸（will ＋原形），一致，正確。

practice.feedback: sat、opened 是過去，卻跳成現在式 starts → 時態不一致。

practice.stem: 選出時態正確的句子（時間真的改變時才換時態）：
practice.answer: I broke my phone last week, so now I use my sister's old one.
options: I broke my phone last week, so now I use my sister's old one.
I break my phone last week, so now I use my sister's old one.
I broke my phone last week, so now I used my sister's old one.
I break my phone last week, so now I used my sister's old one.

distractor_rationales.I break my phone last week, so now I use: last week 是過去，要用過去式 broke，不是現在式 break。
distractor_rationales.I broke my phone last week, so now I use: now（現在）表示現在的狀況，要用現在式 use，不是過去式 used。
distractor_rationales.I break my phone last week, so now I use: 兩個動詞時態都錯（break 應為 broke、used 應為 use）。

practice.feedback: last week → broke（過去）；now → use（現在）；時間真的改變，換時態是正當的。

practice.stem: 填入正確（與故事的過去時態一致）：The dog barked loudly, jumped over the fence, and ____ down the street.（那隻狗大聲吠叫、跳過圍籬，然後沿街跑走了）
options: ran
runs
run
is running

distractor_rationales.runs: 前面 barked、jumped 是過去式；同一串動作要一致，用過去式 ran。
distractor_rationales.run: run 是原形／現在複數；主詞 The dog 單數且為過去敘述，用 ran。
distractor_rationales.is running: 現在進行式與過去的時間軸不一致。

practice.feedback: barked、jumped（過去）→ 保持過去式 ran。

practice.stem: 下面這句時態不一致：『When the bell rang, everyone stands up and leaves the room.』選出改成時態一致（過去）的正確句子：
practice.answer: When the bell rang, everyone stood up and left the room.
options: When the bell rang, everyone stood up and left the room.
When the bell rang, everyone stands up and leaves the room.
When the bell rings, everyone stood up and left the room.
When the bell rang, everyone stand up and leave the room.

distractor_rationales.When the bell rang, everyone stands up a: 這還是原本不一致的句子（rang 過去、stands/leaves 現在），沒有修正。
distractor_rationales.When the bell rings, everyone stood up a: rings 是現在式，又和過去的 stood、left 不一致。
distractor_rationales.When the bell rang, everyone stand up an: stand、leave 是原形；主詞 everyone 且為過去敘述，應為 stood、left。

practice.feedback: 全部改成過去式：rang、stood、left，時態一致。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀出每句，一邊讀一邊確認所有動詞都在同一個時間軸上；讀到時間詞（yesterday／now／every day）時留意它決定了時態。

lines.text: He woke up, got dressed, and ate breakfast.
lines.intonation: 三個過去式動詞節奏一致、句尾下收

lines.text: I lost my keys yesterday, so now I am looking for them.
lines.intonation: yesterday 與 now 稍強調（提示時間改變）、句尾下收
